Container.Name: Seekify
Container.Overview: Self-hosted music server. Scans local libraries, streams audio, and pulls metadata/cover art from MusicBrainz. Download from YouTube (yt-dlp) and Soulseek (aioslsk), generate waveforms, and auto-tag your library. Single Go binary + vanilla JS SPA; mobile-friendly.
Container.Changes:
Changelog
2026-08-10 - Restored Chromecast and AirPlay support. An experimental audio-leveling feature had inadvertently broken remote playback on all browsers - The audio loudness leveling toggle in Settings is temporarily disabled (shown greyed-out with a note); it will return as server-side processing that doesn't conflict with casting - Visualizer continues to work alongside casting
2026-08-09 - Corrupt or incomplete downloads are now caught and rejected at download time, and downloads automatically try another source when one fails - Files that fail to play or seek are surfaced for review so they can be re-downloaded - App no longer freezes during library scans; faster startup (no duplicate scan on boot) - Visualizer performance improved (smoother playback while it runs) - UI cursor fixes and more accurate review flags - General stability and bug fixes 2026-08-02 - Mobile playback: songs start instantly on iPhone/iPad (transcoding added for formats mobile browsers can't stream; desktop unchanged) - Downloads no longer occasionally run twice or leave the queue appearing stuck - Playlist track order and favorite/download toggles stay correct under rapid or concurrent use - Detects audio files that fail to play and surfaces them for review - New "Scan for Corrupt Audio" admin tool to find broken files across the library - New downloads are checked more thoroughly before being added to the library - "Retry All" for failed downloads now reliably retries every failed job - General reliability and bug fixes
2026-07-30 - Home page improvements: multi-column grids on large screens, refreshed section styling, ambient dice animation - Desktop mini-player: seekable progress bar, shuffle/repeat/like/share/download controls - Desktop mini-player no longer closes the playlist when closing the now-playing screen - Home page uses more of the screen on large displays - Context menu cursor fix - Tell search engines not to index the app (deep links keep working) - Experimental optional audio loudness leveling (toggle in Settings → Playback) - Download queue reliability fix and clearer download-source labels - Admin settings reorganized with a section dropdown
2026-07-29 - Playback reliability improvements
2026-07-28 - Visualizer performance and polish - Refined shuffle-dice animation - General stability and bug fixes
2026-07-17 - Finder: cleaner search, better mobile layout, accessibility improvements - More reliable downloads and Soulseek candidate selection - Smarter duplicate/release detection; multi-genre support - Redesigned 3D shuffle die on the home screen - Broad accessibility and responsive-layout polish
2026-07-16 - iPhone lock-screen and background audio fixes - Visualizer live frequency response restored on iPhone
2026-07-15 - Home discovery rotates featured artists and albums daily - Improved queue controls (Play Next, live refresh) - Metadata ranking prefers original releases over compilations - Downloads: pause/resume control and concurrency limits - Better media-client streaming support - Initial Community Apps listing with screenshots
2026-07-10 - Visualizer layout and performance fixes (prevents audio stutter) - Admin default for Now Playing view
2026-07-09 - First public release on GitHub
2026-06 - Early beta
